title: stall warn with empty node_name unactionable on bare Headscale
description: Identity.node_name is documented as 'May be empty on Headscale without node names configured' (kith-core/src/auth.rs:24). The stall warn logs 'peer = %peer_node' (events.rs:398,446). If node_name is empty, the log line emits 'peer=' with no identifying information, making it impossible for an operator to know which SSE client is stalled. An operator running bare Headscale would see a warn with no useful identity. Mitigation: fall back to login_name then user_id, consistent with Identity::display(). Requires capturing the full identity or at least the display() result instead of just node_name. Will generate a support issue from Headscale users who cannot correlate the warn log to a client.
